cards.front: A estas alturas supongo que ya ha viajado por todo el mundo.
cards.back: I suppose he's been all over the world by now.

cards.front: A estas alturas supongo que ya ha ido a Bombay.
cards.back: I suppose he's been to Mumbai by now.

cards.front: A estas alturas supongo que ya has viajado a cada rincón del mundo.
cards.back: I suppose you've been to every corner of the world by now.

cards.front: Supongo que aún no os sentís como en casa; os comprasteis la casa el mes pasado.
cards.back: I suppose you haven't settled in yet, you only bought the house last month.

cards.front: Supongo que aún no se sienten como en casa en su nuevo piso.
cards.back: I suppose they haven't settled into their new flat yet.

cards.front: Supongo que María aún no ha sentado la cabeza, sólo tiene 23 años.
cards.back: I suppose Maria hasn't settled down yet, she's only 23.

cards.front: Supongo que el viaje te gustó, ¡viajaste por todo el mundo!
cards.back: I suppose you liked the trip, you travelled all over the world!

cards.front: Supongo que se enamoraron y sentaron la cabeza.
cards.back: I suppose they fell in love and settled down.

cards.front: Supongo que se fueron a la cama pronto anoche. No cogieron el teléfono.
cards.back: I suppose they went to bed early last night. They didn't answer the phone.

cards.front: Supongo que no te gustó cuando Jane se fue para hacer su viaje alrededor del mundo.
cards.back: I suppose you didn't like it when Jane left to go on her round-the-world trip.

cards.front: Supongo que no te gustó que se fueran.
cards.back: I suppose you didn't like it when they left.

cards.front: Supongo que a Ruth no le molestó que Jane se fuera. ¡Nunca se han llevado bien!
cards.back: I suppose Ruth didn't mind when Jane left. They never got on!

cards.front: A estas alturas supongo que ya han viajado por toda África.
cards.back: I suppose they've been all over Africa by now.

cards.front: Supongo que aún no te has adaptado a tu nuevo trabajo.
cards.back: I suppose you haven't settled into your new job yet.

cards.front: Supongo que no te gustó cuando Ruth se fue del país.
cards.back: I suppose you didn't like it when Ruth left the country.

cards.front: ¿Por casualidad no tendrás un cigarrillo?
cards.back: I don't suppose you have a cigarette?

cards.front: ¿Por casualidad conoces a Ralph James?
cards.back: I don't suppose you know Ralph James?

cards.front: ¿Por casualidad sabes bucear?
cards.back: I don't suppose you know how to scuba dive, do you?

cards.front: ¿Me podrías hacer un favor?
cards.back: I don't suppose you could do me a favour?

cards.front: ¿Me podrías dar un cigarrillo?
cards.back: I don't suppose you could spare a cigarette?

cards.front: ¿Me podrías dar un cigarrillo? (Añade una coletilla.)
cards.back: I don't suppose you could spare a cigarette, could you?

cards.front: ¿Crees que podemos hablar sobre lo que pasó la semana pasada?
cards.back: Do you suppose we could have a chat about what happened last week?

cards.front: ¿Crees que John conoce a Ralph?
cards.back: Do you suppose John knows Ralph?

cards.front: ¿Crees que Alberto puede darme un cigarro?
cards.back: Do you suppose Alberto could spare a cigarette?

cards.front: ¿Qué crees que él quiere?
cards.back: What do you suppose he wants?

cards.front: ¿Qué crees que piensan?
cards.back: What do you suppose they think?

cards.front: ¿Qué crees que piensan sobre lo que pasó la semana pasada?
cards.back: What do you suppose they think about what happened last week?

cards.front: ¿De quién crees que están hablando?
cards.back: Who do you suppose they're talking about?

cards.front: ¿A quién crees que van a elegir?
cards.back: Who do you suppose they're going to pick?

cards.front: ¿A quién crees que van a elegir? ¿A John o a Ralph?
cards.back: Who do you suppose they're going to choose? John or Ralph?

cards.front: Él tenía que estar allí, pero canceló en el último momento. ¡Me decepcionó mucho!
cards.back: He was supposed to be there but he cancelled at the last minute. He really let me down!

cards.front: Tenía que estar allí a las 12, pero he pillado un atasco.
cards.back: I was supposed to be there at 12 but I'm stuck in traffic.

cards.front: Tenía que encontrarme con ella antes de la reunión, pero pillé un atasco.
cards.back: I was supposed to meet her before the meeting but I got stuck in traffic.

cards.front: Se supone que no tenías que ver eso.
cards.back: You weren't supposed to see that.

cards.front: Se supone que no teníamos que enterarnos de que están juntos.
cards.back: We weren't supposed to find out that they're together.

cards.front: Se supone que no tenían que estar allí.
cards.back: They weren't supposed to be there.

cards.front: ¿Cuánto se supone que tenía que durar la reunión?
cards.back: How long was the meeting supposed to last?

cards.front: ¿Cuánto se supone que tenía que durar ese dinero?
cards.back: How long was that money supposed to last?

cards.front: ¡Se supone que ese dinero tenía que durar hasta el viernes! ¡Vaya decepción!
cards.back: That money was supposed to last until Friday! You've really let me down!

cards.front: ¿Se supone que eso es un pato o un perro?
cards.back: Is that supposed to be a duck or a dog?

cards.front: ¡Qué disfraz más bonito! ¿De qué se supone que vas?
cards.back: Nice costume! What are you supposed to be?

cards.front: ¿Se supone que vas de zombi o de demonio?
cards.back: Are you supposed to be a zombie or a devil?

cards.front: Se supone que Venecia está espectacular a finales de primavera.
cards.back: Venice is supposed to be spectacular in late spring.

cards.front: Se supone que ella es muy de fiar. Nunca decepciona a la gente.
cards.back: She's supposed to be very reliable. She never lets people down.

cards.front: ¡Se supone que el nuevo de ventas es guapísimo!
cards.back: The new guy in sales is supposed to be gorgeous!

cards.front: Se supone que mañana va a llover.
cards.back: It's supposed to rain tomorrow.

cards.front: Se supone que mañana va a diluviar.
cards.back: It's supposed to pour down tomorrow.

cards.front: No creo que debamos hacer senderismo. Se supone que va a diluviar.
cards.back: I don't think we should go hiking. It's supposed to pour down.

cards.front: Se supone que va a hacer bueno este fin de semana.
cards.back: It's supposed to be nice at the weekend.

cards.front: Se supone que va a hacer malo este fin de semana.
cards.back: It's supposed to be lousy this weekend.

cards.front: Se supone que va a hacer malo en los próximos días. No creo que debiéramos hacer rafting.
cards.back: It's supposed to be lousy for the next few days. I don't think we should go rafting.

cards.front: Se supone que va a hacer sol todo el fin de semana. Vayamos de paseo en bicicleta.
cards.back: It's supposed to be sunny all weekend. Let's go cycling.

cards.front: Se supone que va a hacer mucho viento pasado mañana, así que hagamos senderismo hoy.
cards.back: It's supposed to be very windy the day after tomorrow, so let's go hiking today.

cards.front: Se supone que va a estar nublado toda la semana.
cards.back: It's supposed to be overcast all week.

cards.front: Se suponía que iba a hacer un calor espantoso el fin de semana pasado, pero no.
cards.back: It was supposed to be roasting last weekend, but it wasn't.

cards.front: Se suponía que iba a hacer un frío horrible la semana pasada, pero no.
cards.back: It was supposed to be freezing last week, but it wasn't.

cards.front: No fuimos a hacer rafting porque se suponía que iba a hacer un frío horrible, pero al final resultó que hacía bueno.
cards.back: We didn't go rafting because it was supposed to be freezing, but it turned out to be nice.

cards.front: Se supone que va a hacer un tiempo malísimo mañana. Quedémonos en casa.
cards.back: The weather is supposed to be awful tomorrow. Let's stay in.

cards.front: Se supone que va a hacer muy buen tiempo toda la semana. ¡Vayamos de paseo en bicicleta!
cards.back: The weather is supposed to be glorious all week. Let's go cycling.

cards.front: Se supone que va a hacer un tiempo horroroso los próximos días.
cards.back: The weather is supposed to be atrocious for the next few days.

cards.front: Supongamos que tomamos tres genes diferentes.
cards.back: Let's suppose we take three different genes.

cards.front: Supongamos que tomamos una muestra de cada grupo.
cards.back: Let's suppose we take one sample from each group.

cards.front: Supongamos que no introducimos un nuevo gen en la muestra. ¿Qué pasaría?
cards.back: Let's suppose we don't introduce a new gene to the sample. What would happen?

cards.front: Supongamos que el cliente rechaza la oferta.
cards.back: Let's just suppose that the customer rejects the offer.

cards.front: Supongamos por un momento que a nadie le gusta el nuevo producto.
cards.back: Let's just suppose for a moment that nobody likes the new product.

cards.front: Supongamos por un momento que el científico toma una muestra de cada grupo.
cards.back: Let's just suppose for a moment that the scientist takes one sample from each group.

cards.front: Si tomáramos una muestra de agua del río, ¿qué encontraríamos?
cards.back: Were we to take a water sample from the river, what would we find?

cards.front: Si probáramos el grupo A, ¿qué pasaría?
cards.back: Were we to test group A, what would happen?

cards.front: Si nos saliera un resultado positivo, continuaríamos el experimento.
cards.back: Were we to get a positive result, we would continue the experiment.

cards.front: Supongamos que tomáramos una muestra nueva del río.
cards.back: Let's suppose we were to take a new sample from the river.

cards.front: Supongamos que los científicos probaran el grupo B antes del grupo A.
cards.back: Let's suppose the scientists were to test group B before group A.

cards.front: Supongamos que nos saliera un resultado negativo. ¿Qué pasaría?
cards.back: Let's just suppose we were to get a negative result, what would happen?

cards.front: Supongamos que damos el producto a tres grupos.
cards.back: Let's say we give the product to three groups.

cards.front: Supongamos que el primer grupo rechaza el producto.
cards.back: Let's say the first group rejects the product.

cards.front: Supongamos que nos sale un resultado positivo del segundo y tercer grupos.
cards.back: Let's say we get a positive result from the second and third group.

cards.front: Supongo que Jane y Tom irán a cada uno de los rincones de la India.
cards.back: I imagine Jane and Tom will go to every corner of India.

cards.front: Supongo que viajarás por todo el mundo.
cards.back: I imagine you'll travel all over the world.

cards.front: Supongo que se asentarán en la ciudad.
cards.back: I imagine they'll settle down in the city.

cards.front: Supongo que él estará de vuelta en casa por Navidad.
cards.back: I assume he'll be home for Christmas.

cards.front: Supongo que no se acomodarán hasta después de Navidad.
cards.back: I assume they won't settle in until after Christmas.

cards.front: Supongo que el novio de Corinne estará aquí para las vacaciones de verano.
cards.back: I presume Corinne's boyfriend will be here for the summer holidays.

cards.front: Supongo que él abandonará el país si pierde su trabajo.
cards.back: I figure he'll leave the country if he loses his job.

cards.front: Supongo que él abandonará la empresa si no consigue su ascenso.
cards.back: I figure he'll leave the company if he doesn't get his promotion.

cards.front: ¿Crees que irán de caminata el domingo? ¡Supongo!
cards.back: Do you think they'll go hiking on Sunday? I figure!

cards.front: Supongo que estaremos ahí a las 12.
cards.back: I guess we'll be there at 12 o'clock.

cards.front: Los científicos tomarán muestras de ambos grupos, supongo.
cards.back: The scientists will take samples from both groups, I guess.

cards.front: Supongo que no harán ciclismo este fin de semana. Se supone que va a hacer muy malo.
cards.back: I guess they won't go cycling this weekend. The weather's supposed to be awful.

cards.front: Supongo que me quedaré en casa esta noche. Se supone que va a hacer mucho viento.
cards.back: I reckon I'll stay in tonight. It's supposed to be really windy.

cards.front: Supongo que obtendremos un resultado positivo si introducimos un gen nuevo a la muestra.
cards.back: I reckon we'll get a positive result if we introduce a new gene to the sample.

cards.front: Supongo que mañana será un día precioso.
cards.back: I reckon it will be a lovely day tomorrow.
